ProgramUnit.Name: ABO_DESCRIPTION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure abo_description is
 v_local_time date;
begin
 if :s_quarantine_type = 'RT'
 then
 begin
--Modified for both schemes to coexist
 select distinct abo_desc
 into :returns.s_abo_desc
 from vserv_abo, shipped_products
 where abo_code = blood_type
 and unit_id = :returns.unit_id
 and product_code = :returns.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:returns.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 begin
--Modified for both scheme to coexist
 select distinct abo_desc, exp_date
 into :returns.s_abo_desc, :returns.exp_date
 from vserv_abo, active_products
 where abo_code = blood_type
 and unit_id = :returns.unit_id
 and product_code = :returns.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 AND unit_scheme_type = decode(:returns.chk_digit,NULL,'C','I')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 
 -- time zone change --03/09/11--sandip
 /*if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:returns.exp_date,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :returns.s_exp_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 else
 :returns.s_exp_date := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 end if; 
 */
 :returns.s_exp_date := to_date(to_char(:RETURNS.EXP_DATE,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: RETURN_QUARANTINE_INFO
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure return_quarantine_info is
 found_flag varchar2(1) := 'N';
 v_local_time date;
 cursor c1 is
 select unit_id, coll_date, product_code, aliquot, exp_date, 
 customer_id, return_reason_code
 from return_items
 where move_date is null
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 order by unit_id;
 cursor c2 is
 select unit_id, coll_date, product_code, aliquot, qu_reason
 from quarantine_products
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 group by unit_id , coll_date, product_code, aliquot, qu_reason
 order by unit_id;
 --Added by HCL : Group by done to avoid multiple display of same unit with multiple quarantine reasons 
begin
 :s_found_count := 0;
 go_block('returns');
 begin
 if :s_quarantine_type = 'RT' -- Return product
 then
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 found_flag := 'Y';
 :returns.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 --chk_digit_query returns the check digit for the unit ID
 :returns.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(:returns.unit_id,
 c1_rec.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 :returns.product_code := c1_rec.product_code;
 :returns.aliquot := c1_rec.aliquot;
 :returns.exp_date := c1_rec.exp_date;
 
 -- time zone change --03/09/11--sandip
 /*
 if Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(:returns.exp_date,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 :returns.s_exp_date := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 else
 :returns.s_exp_date := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 end if; 
 */
 
 :returns.s_exp_date := to_date(to_char(:returns.EXP_DATE,'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI'),'DD-MON-YYYY HH24:MI');
 
 abo_description;
 get_reason(c1_rec.return_reason_code,'R');
 :s_found_count := :s_found_count + 1;
 begin
 select name into :customer
 from customers
 where chapter_id = :Global.chapter_id
 and customer_id = c1_rec.customer_id
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date, sysdate+1);
 exception
 when no_data_found
 then
 null;
 when others
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 down;
 end loop;
 else -- Quarantine product
 for c2_rec in c2
 loop
 found_flag := 'Y';
 :returns.unit_id := c2_rec.unit_id;
 --chk_digit_query returns the check digit for the unit ID
 :returns.chk_digit := chk_digit_query(c2_rec.unit_id,
 c2_rec.coll_date,:GLOBAL.chapter_id);
 :returns.product_code := c2_rec.product_code;
 :returns.aliquot := c2_rec.aliquot;
 abo_description;
 get_reason(c2_rec.qu_reason, 'Q');
 :s_found_count := :s_found_count + 1;
 down;
 end loop;
 end if;
 if found_flag = 'N'
 then
 show_error_dist('0358');
 GO_ITEM('ctrl_blk_1.s_quarantine_type');
 else
 clear_record;
 first_record;
 :s_unit_indicator := '>';
-- HCL GO_ITEM('returns.unit_id');
 end if;
 end;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_REASON
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE GET_REASON(p_reason_code in varchar2, p_from in varchar2) IS
BEGIN
 IF p_from = 'R' THEN
 SELECT code, code_desc 
 INTO :returns.reason_code, :returns.reason
 FROM vserv_return_reasons 
 WHERE code = p_reason_code
 AND rownum = 1;
 ELSIF p_from = 'Q' THEN
 SELECT code, code_desc 
 INTO :returns.reason_code, :returns.reason
 FROM vserv_master 
 WHERE code_type = 'QURSN'
 AND code = p_reason_code
 AND rownum = 1;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN others THEN
 null;
END;
